# `tak log`

- **Usage:** `tak log [FLAGS] [REV]`

Show each benchmark's measurements over first-parent history.

One table per benchmark and runner class, newest commit first, with the change in instruction count from the previous measurement. Commits with nothing recorded are skipped. `--html` writes the same history as a self-contained page of charts instead.

## Arguments
- **`[REV]`** — Revision to walk back from. Defaults to HEAD.

  **Default:** `HEAD`

## Flags
- **`-n --limit <LIMIT>`** — Most recent recorded commits to show.

  **Default:** `30`
- **`--bench <NAME>`** — Show only this benchmark. Repeatable.
- **`--html <PATH>`** — Write a self-contained HTML report to PATH instead of printing.
- **`--remote <REMOTE>`** — Remote to refresh notes from.

  **Default:** `origin`
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
